answer: Each identity must hold a council tax bill in its own name, verified live against the council register at about $120 a month per fake. A farm needs a distinct bill per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost $120,000 every month plus a register check each. The ripple of cheap aliases fades: every fake adds another bill, the prism of the council register exposes duplicate names at one address, and the knoll of scale rises with every fake.
